about: The licensed files under assets/, which a public repo can't hold: written by tool/asset_manifest.py from the private repo's assets/, read by tool/gen_placeholders.py (docs/assets.md "Placeholder art"). Their sha256s are in tool/assets.sha256.

kinds.character: a Tiny RPG strip of square frames facing right, the feet at `feet` (lib/main.dart _feet, _frame); baked_shadow: the strip has the shadow colour (83,69,69) in rows 55-59 (only the Soldier's; TdGame.onLoad clears it, test/sprites_test.dart)
kinds.shadow: the ground shadow under a character, the shadow colour (83,69,69) in rows 55-59, one frame
kinds.arrow: a projectile pointing right, one frame (lib/main.dart _arrows)
kinds.burst: an effect strip of square frames: tiny_fx_* sit on the feet, fx_* are centred on the body (lib/main.dart _burstStrip, hero_skill_fx.dart); tiny_fx_wizard_* are the wizard's shots and their hits, a frame's point (55, 51) or (53, 50) on the shot (lib/wizard_fx.dart WizardMagic)
kinds.ui: a Cute Fantasy UI sheet: with frame, a grid of cells (icons, buttons, the click and loading frames); without, the code cuts rects of its own out of it (docs/ui-hud.md)
kinds.floor: the battle field's floor (tool/import_battle_floor.py, decisions-log 228, 244, 263): GandalfHardcore FREE Platformer pieces (Tall Grass's blades in rows, a ground line of Pine forest's flower tufts and Decor's ferns, bushes and rocks doubled, Decor's pebbles, a Floor Tiles1 cell's top rows along the bottom, under the field's) at the parallax layers' 5 px a world unit, drawn whole and tiled sideways with the field (lib/main.dart floorCopies); opaque from the horizon (row 40) down, clear above it but for the ground line and the blade tips
kinds.props: the battle's props line at the horizon (tool/import_battle_floor.py, decisions-log 244): GandalfHardcore FREE Platformer pieces (Pine forest's trunks, pine and log, Decor's boulders, rocks, bushes and ferns, doubled; Tree1 and Tree2) at the parallax layers' 5 px a world unit, from the band's top down to their feet two rows over the bottom, drawn whole and tiled sideways (lib/main.dart propsCopies); clear between the props
kinds.clouds: the battle's clouds (tool/import_battle_floor.py, decisions-log 244): GandalfHardcore FREE Platformer's cloud1..cloud6 scattered over a clear strip at the parallax layers' 5 px a world unit, drawn whole, tiled sideways and drifting (lib/main.dart cloudCopies)
kinds.step: the spawn bar's step (tool/import_battle_floor.py, decisions-log 287, 295): a strip of ground at the parallax layers' 5 px a world unit, a little hill (32 px of low ground, its grass 60 rows down; a slope up over 96; 96 of the step's top; a slope down over 96; 32 of low ground), every column GandalfHardcore FREE Platformer's Floor Tiles1 grass-topped cell's lowered to the ground's height there, earth under it; cut into pieces (lib/spawn_bar.dart _barStep: the slopes, the top's middle cell tiled, the earth stretched; lib/main.dart _underFloor)
kinds.icon: Cute Fantasy Icons Premium's 16 px art doubled: a loot icon (item_<Item>, relic_<Relic>), one frame drawn whole (TdGame._icon in lib/main.dart, IconRef in lib/pusaka_catalog.dart); artifact_icons.png, the Artifacts' icons on a grid of 32x32 cells, one a kind (lib/artifact_icons.dart); town_mark.png and town_mug.png, the Towns' hammer and beer mug, one frame drawn whole each (lib/town_look.dart); mat_<Mat>, a material's, one frame drawn whole (TdGame._icon)
kinds.town: a GandalfHardcore FREE Platformer piece of the Town scene (tool/import_town.py, lib/town_art.dart): the parallax layers and the castle (town_bg_1..5: the near pines and ground .. the sky, also the battle's band above the field, lib/main.dart backdropLayers; town_castle), drawn whole and tiled sideways; the street (town_ground: a grass top over its earth, tiled along it); the house's 16x16 cells (town_house; the porch's are 16x8 at the top of theirs); the smithy's 64x64 frames (row 0 the furnace, row 1 the sawmill) and the campfire's 32x32 ones (a row a loop); single pieces (town_tent, town_ore, town_pine); and the props' atlas (town_props), its rects in cells; the Towns' identities (decisions-log 326): the Autumn and Winter sets (town_autumn_bg_1..5, town_autumn_castle, town_winter_*), drawn as the Normal one, their streets (town_ground_autumn, town_ground_winter) and the yards' atlas (town_yards), its rects in cells (an animation's frames side by side in its cell)
kinds.npc: the Town's smith (tool/import_smith.py, lib/town_smith_art.dart, decisions-log 265): the Mana Seed Character Base demo's paper doll (body, outfit, hair, the mace for a hammer) facing right at Pixel Crawler's anvil, a strip of frames (backswing, raised, swing, strike, rest), the anvil at the same place in each, his feet on the frame's bottom row; drawn at 1 world px a sprite px
